"Kalki was his own enemy because his romance and adventure sweep you along so fast you don't have time to pause."
In this profound analysis, translator and scholar Gowri Ramnarayan reveals the "bulky" truth behind India's most beloved historical novel, Ponniyin Selvan. Having read the book every year of her life since age nine, Ramnarayan explains how her recent translation project (published as Crowning Sacrifice in 2025) allowed her to see the novel not just as a story, but as a political and ethical manifesto for a newly independent India.
Thank you for watching our video!
